source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Whenever a model of this unit is **destroyed**, you roll 1 D6. On a 3+:

- it is not removed yet
- it can shoot once the attacking unit has finished its attacks
- after that, it is removed
- Hazardous tests for the attacks it makes then are passed automatically

ability.trigger: a model in this unit is destroyed

effects: can shoot once the attacking unit has finished its attacks
Hazardous tests for the attacks it makes then are passed automatically
